packageRules.description: Pinned on purpose: the engine stays on Python 3.11 for madmom and allin1 (engine/.python-version, requires-python).

torchaudio wheels are built against one torch version: update them together. torchaudio has no release after 2.11.0 (it pins torch==2.11.0), which demucs and allin1 need: stay below 2.12 until that changes.
Tauri npm packages and Rust crates must stay on the same major.minor.
React runtime and its type packages move together.
